newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner CEO sees no further acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner CEO sees no further acquisitions.

text.p: Time Warner Inc Chairman and CEO Gerald Levin said Wednesday that the company's merger with Turner Broadcasting System Inc is "strategically complete" and the company sees no further acquisitions in the near future.
"We are not out making any more acquisitions," Levin said in a briefing with reporters after the company released its first quarter earnings.
Levin added, "My focus is on driving the growth of the businesses."
Time Warner, which now has $17.5 billion in debt, said it anticipated lowering its debt-to-cash flow ratio to 3.75 by the end of 1997 from 4.1 at the end of 1996.
